description: Authorizes campaign objective receipt categories in the product-neutral boilerplate. A machine receipt satisfies a category only when its recorded argv equals one of the category's allowlisted argv exactly, its evidence_commit equals the active campaign audit base, and it carries the audit coordinator round/nonce binding. A runner manifest satisfies a category only when the category allows manifests and the manifest is an accepted exact-commit runner receipt whose recorded capabilities contain the exact capability that runs the category's allowlisted probe command (resolved through .factory/capability-contracts.json): every [manifest:] reference must be an exact signed record in the runner-evidence aggregate at the audit base, validated by .factory/tools/check-factory-runner-evidence.py --verify-manifest. Manifest matching is exact capability evidence, never a path-substring proxy: the manifest path is ignored. Standalone/minimal, unsigned, fabricated, and path-category-only manifests are rejected. Arbitrary commands (for example a bare `true`) are never allowed; receipt tags alone never authorize. The allowlists bind each category to the generic boilerplate's own gate tooling; an adopting product replaces this policy with its product commands before running campaigns.
